svg.title: Figure 2-6: SF-12 at the lift: a person steps onto the keep-clear zone and the lift stops; the zone against the walk
svg.desc: Six boxes from stepping onto the zone through the keep-clear device, the logic, the lift power, the brake's assumed engagement and the standstill; a time axis to 0.4 s with the 200 ms target marked; a distance bar of the 0.27 m walked during the reaction and 0.08 m during the brake inside the 0.55 m radius, leaving 0.20 m; a top view of the base, the column, the hatched keep-clear ring and the person at its edge and at standstill.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 2-6 SF-12 at the lift: a person steps onto the keep-clear zone and the lift stops; the zone against the walk

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: §2 row SF-12: 100 + 50 + 20 = 170 ms against the 200 ms target, CFG-002; the lift brake's engagement time is unknown: drawn at 0.05 s. The lift moves at 18 mm/s and travels 3.6 mm in the 200 ms of SR-12.04; K = 1.6 m/s.

svg.text: A person stepping onto the zone's edge walks 0.27 m before power is removed and 0.08 m more while the brake engages (0.05 s assumed): 0.35 m of the 0.55 m radius, leaving 0.20 m to the column.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lift itself moves 3.6 mm in the 200 ms target: the zone's radius and the brake's time size the hazard, not the lift's speed (§4.5). The radius is the simulation track's assumption until SR-12.03's device is chosen.

svg.text: Drawn to WP-S-04 v0.2 planning values (t_r 0.17 s, lift brake 0.05 s assumed, keep-clear radius 0.55 m assumed). A loop diagram shows the arithmetic of a stop; it does not show that a measure works.
